title: Optimization: Minimum Material
body:
An open rectangular tank with a square base must have a volume of 32 m$^3$. The base costs R150 per m$^2$ and the sides cost R100 per m$^2$.

Let the side of the square base be $x$ metres and the height be $h$ metres.

Find the dimensions that will minimise the total cost of materials.
